F1: Ruby replaces the five-argument method, so the emoji resize job now raises ArgumentError.
F2: The fixed client limit diverges from configured attachment limits, allowing rejected uploads and blocking otherwise permitted ones.
F3: The loop ignores failed conversions and retries silently before passing the oversized file to validation.
F4: Downloads can be silently truncated, then resized below the validation limit and stored without detecting the incomplete download.
F5: Disabling animated thumbnails now causes oversized uploaded GIF originals to be flattened to their first frame.
